description: One interview in full — metadata plus the transcript of what the guest actually said. Read this before summarizing an interview or drafting pages from it: the transcript is the source you work from, and your compass skill has the rules for typing and splitting what's in it. Ids come from compass_interviews_list or compass_inbox_list.
